Here are the extracted quantitative parameters and their values from the text:

1. Temperature for maintaining explanted inguinal lymph nodes: 37°C
2. Gas mixture for perfusion: 95% O\(_2\) and 5% CO\(_2\)
3. Average velocity of T cells in lymph nodes: 11–14 μm per minute
4. Velocity of dendritic cells (DCs) in lymph nodes: 3–6 μm per minute
5. Time post-injection for DCs to be found in draining lymph nodes: Approximately 12–18 hours
6. Time for DCs to lose motility and integrate into the lymph-node network: Within 3 days
